name: DaxLib.SVG.Transforms
description: Generates transform string for SVG elements

parameters.name: rotate
parameters.description: Optional: Rotation with optional center point (e.g., "45" or "45 50 50")

parameters.name: skewX
parameters.description: Optional: Horizontal skew angle in degrees

parameters.name: skewY
parameters.description: Optional: Vertical skew angle in degrees

return_description: A transform attribute value that can be used with the transform attribute of SVG elements.
code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Transforms' =
		(
			translate: STRING,
			rotate: STRING,
			scale: STRING,
			skewX: STRING,
			skewY: STRING
		) =>

			IF(NOT ISBLANK(translate), "translate(" & translate & ") ") &
			IF(NOT ISBLANK(rotate), "rotate(" & rotate & ") ") &
			IF(NOT ISBLANK(scale), "scale(" & scale & ") ") &
			IF(NOT ISBLANK(skewX), "skewX(" & skewX & ") ") &
			IF(NOT ISBLANK(skewY), "skewY(" & skewY & ") ")
